page_title: SOU 2-3 LEI | Southampton v Leicester 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Russell Martin is stunned as referee Anthony Taylor shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+8' 2 - 3 Jordan Ayew (Leicester) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes into the bottom right corner and hits the net.
90+8' The referee awards a corner and Harry Winks (Leicester) goes over to take it.
90+8' Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Leicester are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

90+4' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
90+2' Southampton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Now Southampton have a corner.

90+1' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play. Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Leicester failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90' Leicester show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Leicester win a corner kick.
89' Wonderful movement by Leicester. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
88' Substitution. Stephy Mavididi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
85' 45:55 – the ratio of ball possession.
84' William Smallbone (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
83' Southampton couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
81' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
79' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) is adjudged offside.
78' Russell Martin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) replacing Tyler Dibling.
78' Substitution. Ryan Manning makes his way off the pitch and Charlie Taylor (Southampton) comes on as his replacement.
74' 2 - 2 Goal! Jamie Vardy (Leicester) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Aaron Ramsdale into left side of the goal.
74' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is going to take the penalty!
73' The referee interrupts the game and gives a red card to Ryan Fraser (Southampton). He can take an early bath.
73' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Leicester!

72' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Southampton.
72' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
72' OFF THE BAR! Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
70' Harry Winks (Leicester) gets a yellow card. The referee Anthony Taylor made the right call.
69' A corner kick by Southampton is thwarted by the well prepared Mads Hermansen (Leicester).
68' Steven Cooper has decided to make a change. Jordan Ayew (Leicester) replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
68' Substitution. Cameron Archer is replaced by Paul Onuachu (Southampton).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mateus Fernandes as he is replaced by William Smallbone (Southampton).
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.
67' Southampton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Good work from Southampton as they win a corner.

66' Ryan Fraser (Southampton) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Southampton.

64' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Issahaku Fatawu plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
63' Half-chance! Ryan Fraser (Southampton) plays a pass into the box, but Mads Hermansen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) for a tough tackle.
62' Russell Martin decides to make a substitution. Yukinari Sugawara will be replaced by Ryan Fraser (Southampton).
59' Substitution. Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) replaces Victor Kristiansen.
57' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
57' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
56' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:0.
54' Ryan Manning (Southampton) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
53' The game is interrupted now, Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is awarded a yellow card.
52' Southampton fail to score from a corner as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaps to collect the ball.
51' Southampton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' The referee Anthony Taylor awards Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) a yellow card.
48' The linesman makes the right call and Southampton will have a corner.
46' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Oliver Skipp and he is replaced by Harry Winks (Leicester).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Ryan Manning (Southampton) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Wonderful movement by Southampton. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
42' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.

41' Leicester slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
38' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Leicester.
36' The whistle blows and Tyler Dibling (Southampton) is booked for an infringement.
35' The resulting set piece from Leicester is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) picks up a yellow card.

33' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Leicester will take a corner.
32' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
31' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jamie Vardy (Leicester), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
28' 2 - 0 Goal! Kyle Walker-Peters feeds Joe Aribo (Southampton), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:0.
28' Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
25' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
24' Wonderful movement by Leicester. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Wout Faes (Leicester) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' Wout Faes (Leicester) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
20' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

19' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jamie Vardy (Leicester) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Leicester force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

14' What an opportunity! James Justin (Leicester) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.

12' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Southampton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Mateus Fernandes (Southampton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

8' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Cameron Archer (Southampton) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
6' Anthony Taylor has issued a yellow card to Ryan Manning (Southampton).
6' CHANCE! Joe Aribo (Southampton) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
5' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
5' Southampton are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The referee signals a corner kick to Southampton.
3' The corner is swung in but Southampton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' Southampton are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Southampton will take a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Southampton will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
